title: Satisfiability of Equality Equations
summary: Given an array of strings representing variable equations as 'xi==yi' or 'xi!=yi', determine if a consistent integer assignment to variables is possible to satisfy all equations, returning true or false accordingly.
statement: Given an array of strings representing variable equations as 'xi==yi' or 'xi!=yi', determine if a consistent integer assignment to variables is possible to satisfy all equations, returning true or false accordingly.
constraints: Each equation compares two lowercase one-letter variables with == or !=.
Return whether all equations can hold simultaneously.
hints: Equalities form connected components that must share one value.
Union every equality first, then inspect inequalities.
Reject an inequality whose endpoints have the same representative.
Components satisfy all equalities, and distinct component values can satisfy every remaining inequality.
editorial: Components satisfy all equalities, and distinct component values can satisfy every remaining inequality.
